title: Handle failure to manually create E-Document from posted doc with no …
summary: E-Document creation now correctly reports failure when a posted document cannot be converted to an e-document instead of incorrectly showing a success message.
key_points: The result of e-document creation is now propagated back through the call chain
Users see 'The e-document could not be created.' when creation fails
Fixes cases where no explicit error prevented the false success message
Multiple page extensions updated to handle the creation result
Resolves false positive feedback when document type is unsupported
